field_notes.basis_spread: Identifier spreads are stated as percentages, not bps literals.
field_notes.interest_rate: The percent sign is optional because one sampled identifier states Interest Rate 8.92 without it.
field_notes.pik_rate: Only parenthetical '(incl. X% PIK)' is extracted safely; bare X% PIK can occupy the spread phrase and is not unambiguously a separate spread.
field_notes.old_era: Older identifiers contain issuer/type/tranche only; structured-twin rates are not treated as identifier text.

evidence: Recent bundle debt identifiers embed reference codes S or P, percentage spreads, stated interest rates, optional inclusive PIK, and M/D/YYYY maturity dates.
Older 2023-03-31 through 2025-06-30 samples contain issuer and tranche/index only despite non-null structured twins, so the grammar does not extract those source-column values.
